serviceName: UP Chamal campaign email (DKIM, MAIL FROM, DMARC)
description: Lets UP Chamal, the fundraising platform by Studio IP, send a campaign's email from the organization's own domain through Amazon SES: three DKIM records, a MAIL FROM subdomain (bounce) with its MX record and SPF rule, and a DMARC policy. Used only when the domain has no DMARC record yet. Apply with the host parameter to set up a subdomain.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: the Easy DKIM tokens Amazon SES issues for the domain; dkimzone: the Amazon SES DKIM zone of the region without the amazonses.com suffix (dkim, or dkim.<region> in newer regions, e.g. dkim.il-central-1); region: the Amazon SES region that receives bounces (e.g. il-central-1); dmarcpolicy: the DMARC policy (none, quarantine or reject)
